description: Who is running through which sequence: for a lead (leadId) or for a sequence (sequenceId), each enrolment's status (active, finished or stopped), the step it is on and when it is next due. This is how to answer "why did this lead get, or not get, the follow-up" — a lead with no enrolment was never enrolled, and activating a sequence enrols future leads, not past ones. At most 100 rows, oldest first.

project.description: A project id from list_projects. Runs this call in that project instead of the connection default.
